title: Landing page that converts honestly: working CTAs and forms, legal page drafts, sitemap, no unverifiable claims
goal: Turn the landing page into a real front door: every button works, visitors can ask for a demo or a trial, and nothing on it claims what cannot be proven.
why: landing/index.html: every CTA is href="#", no form or fetch, footer legal links are "#", og-image.png, favicon and sitemap.xml (named in robots.txt) do not exist, and it shows unverified "500+ Travel Agencies", "$2.4M+", "99.9% Uptime", six named agencies, three named testimonials and an aggregateRating 4.9 from 127 ratings; prices shown are per-user USD that disagree with the decided INR plans; lucide loads from unpkg @latest.
steps: Backend: master 0018 platform_enquiries (id, kind contact|demo|signup, name, email, phone, company, country, agents_count INTEGER, message, source_url, ip_hash, status new|contacted|converted|spam, created_at). routes/public-enquiries.ts mounted at /api/v1/public/enquiries before authMiddleware (index.ts route registration only): POST validates with zod, honeypot field `website` must be empty, limits 5/hour/IP and 3/day/email (middleware/rate-limiter.ts), 10 KB body cap, verifies Cloudflare Turnstile when TURNSTILE_SECRET is set (fetch to challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify; mocked in tests), stores the row, notifies PLATFORM_SUPPORT_EMAIL via sendTransactional(platform_enquiry), answers 202 with no echo of stored data. CORS for this route allows the landing origin from CORS_ORIGINS.

Landing: one config file landing/config.js ({ apiBase, appDownloadUrl, demoVideoUrl, whatsappNumber, turnstileSiteKey }) read by main.js; CTAs: "Start free trial" and pricing buttons open the signup form (kind signup), "Book a demo" opens kind demo, "Contact" kind contact; forms post with fetch, show success/failure states, are keyboard and screen-reader accessible; WhatsApp button only rendered when whatsappNumber is set; remove the placeholder tel:+919876543210.

Pricing section renders from GET /api/v1/public/plans?market=IN (other markets only when the catalogue has active rows; R109 adds the endpoint): flat price per agency per year, included users, price per extra user, monthly AI credits, and the included monthly SMS, WhatsApp, login-code and call-minute caps, with the line "Need more? Upgrade or add credit packs". Static fallback with the decided India prices (Basic ₹12,000 / Pro ₹18,000 / Enterprise ₹24,000 per agency per year, 5 / 15 / 100 users) when the API is unreachable. No per-user pricing anywhere (owner decision 2026-10-14).

Remove unverifiable claims (Q12 default): the 500+ / $2.4M / 99.9% stats, named agency logos, named testimonials and the aggregateRating JSON-LD; replace with product facts (feature counts from docs/FEATURES.md, "Built for Indian tour operators") and a "Be one of our first agencies" pilot message. Keep JSON-LD SoftwareApplication without ratings.

Legal drafts in landing/legal/*.html: privacy policy, terms, DPA, sub-processor list (Cloudflare, SendGrid, Twilio (or the telephony provider named in the ADR-001 addendum), Anthropic or Workers AI, Google Maps, Oracle) clearly marked "Draft for legal review, not in force"; footer links point to them; About/Blog/API links removed until they exist.

og-image.png (1200x630) and favicon.svg generated from the desktop icon SVG (R114 build-resources/icon.svg if present, else a simple wordmark) with Playwright screenshot of an HTML template; sitemap.xml lists index and legal pages; robots.txt keeps the sitemap line.
Pin lucide to an exact version on cdnjs or unpkg (no @latest) with a fallback that does not break layout if it fails to load.
landing/scripts/check-links.mjs: starts a static server on landing/, crawls every internal href and src, fails on any 404 or "#"-only CTA link.
tests: backend/test/public-enquiries.test.ts: valid demo request -> 202 + row + outbox notification; honeypot filled -> 202 but no row (silently dropped); 6th request in an hour from one IP -> 429; Turnstile on with mocked failure -> 400; oversized body -> 413.
Manual: fill each form against fix-stack slot 1 and confirm the enquiry row (record in report).
acceptance: No unverifiable claim remains (grep for 500+, 2.4M, 99.9, aggregateRating).
Forms post to the local API and show success.
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failed files and passed >= the last merged count (1296 on 2026-10-14)
goLiveVerify: Lawyer review of the legal drafts; Turnstile keys; hosting (R118 terraform) and domain; Lighthouse on the deployed page.
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.
landing/ is plain HTML/CSS/JS with no build step: keep it that way.
R103 runs in parallel and does not touch index.ts; you may add one route mount line there.
